svg.text: 50 of 50 features native (100%). Generated from docs/port_status.json by tools/status_treemap.py.

g.title: Vertex fog: native since 2026-10-15 (b7fc671). the game's fog factors, on every layer (sky and far landscape too)
Front fog: native since 2026-10-14 (ab142b6). drawFrontFog
Bloom: native since 2026-10-16 (4bb6054). the game's own strength (no scale by eye) and one blur round, as the GS chain; mean diff 15.0 vs 14.7 with the old tuning, altar offset 14.9 vs 18.6

Distance fog: native since 2026-10-15 (64b72f1). zFog as the game does it: one pass at layer 4 by depth slices over bgEnd's background copy, on by default (SOTC_NATIVE_ZFOG=0); far cliffs paler than the GS (polish)
Shadows: native since 2026-10-15 (0c3a518). stencil volumes (rigid and skinned paths), soft as shadowDraw: mask reduced, blurred, darkened; on by default
Reflections: native since 2026-10-15 (0fd00e9). mirrored layers 12/13 drawn off-screen, sampled by the 0x2200 surfaces in layer 15; tint alpha matched by measurement

Water refraction: native since 2026-10-15 (47f8465). layer 9: the 0x2200 surfaces show the picture before that layer, reduced 256 -> 128 -> 256; the layer 15 reflection covers it (alpha 1, as on the PS2)
Refraction: native since 2026-10-16 (). underwater waves: refractionEnd's grid of strips (0x109c610) through the 2D path on the screen copy at layer 19 (SOTC_FORCE_UNDERWATER=1 shows it anywhere)

Particles: native since 2026-10-16 (299159f). microcode 7 expansion of every type in the route: 1 billboards, 2/4/7 by the environment matrix with its translation, 3 streaks, 4 lit fans (routine 0xe48 lighting from VU 26/27), 7 with a texture cell each

Screen blur: native since 2026-10-16 (). screenBlur (zoom/turn blur; cameraBlur goes through it) and feedbackBlur/feedbackBlur2 (the last frame shown over the new one at layer 29, by the layer's root ALPHA as the GS does)
Depth of field: native since 2026-10-15 (ae4246f). 256 x 256 blurred copy laid over the pixels beyond the focus in slices by GS Z, as depthOfField (SOTC_NATIVE_NODOF)

Colossus death effect: native since 2026-10-16 (). bossDeathEffect's layer-8 composite native; the fan bit 0 draws into the 256 x 256 buffer that End's first copy overwrites whole before anything reads it (GS trace with SOTC_FORCE_BOSSFAN): no effect on the picture, left out

Cutscene glow (bossDeathEffect): native since 2026-10-16 (). as the GS: layer 8 drawn apart on the scene's depth, reduced 256/128/64 and blurred, laid over sharp (0x11862c4) and blurred (0x11862c0) in the tint; on by default (SOTC_NATIVE_NOGLOW); Metal and Mac GL, not on the Vita yet (vitaGL framebuffers cannot share the depth)
Higher resolution (512x448 x up to 4): native since 2026-10-17 (72b6c63). 3x on the Mac, shown filtered at full size; effects measured in PS2 pixels; F10 tuning panel
Models, LOD and part visibility: native since 2026-10-14 (b8a0ffb). modelDisp read from the game's own model data
Textures (4/8-bit CLUT): native since 2026-10-14 (8c4bb05). NTO2 textures decoded once, cached by content
Textures (32-bit): native since 2026-10-14 (3591a51). PSMCT32
Materials and draw layers: native since 2026-10-14 (8daaafc). ALPHA blends, modelGetDlLayer order
Surface skip rules: native since 2026-10-14 (9fa0953). boss effect, shadow effect, underwater
Instance opacity: native since 2026-10-14 (20ba0c5). fading instances
Skinned characters: native since 2026-10-14 (9fa0953). bone palette, skinned on the CPU
Lighting: native since 2026-10-14 (600a17e). the instance's lights, VU1 lit formula
Two-texture surfaces: native since 2026-10-14 (57de9ac). second pass by ALPHA_2
Cloth and hair: native since 2026-10-14 (e60af7b). meshDisp grids
Mip levels: native since 2026-10-15 (2744664). every level decoded; the level picked as the GS does from TEX1 (log2(w) x 2^L + K, NTO2 +0x78/+0x90/+0x94), SOTC_NATIVE_NOMIPS
Scrolling texture coordinates: native since 2026-10-15 (e231623). the STROW texTransResolve builds per texture: 16-bit row at *(NTO2 +0xc), +4, added to S/T (SOTC_NATIVE_NOROW)
Menu and title sprites: native since 2026-10-14 (9b145ec). spriteDrawSprite
Sprite variants: native since 2026-10-14 (20ba0c5). UV, ST, UV2, ST2, TexNoSet
Screen fades: native since 2026-10-14 (20ba0c5). fadeScreen
Cinema bars: native since 2026-10-14 (20ba0c5). drawDemoBar
Subtitles: native since 2026-10-14 (ff7152c). pre-rendered lines
HUD gauges: native since 2026-10-14 (ff7152c). grip and health circles
Loading indicator: native since 2026-10-14 (ff7152c). lines
Windows: native since 2026-10-14 (ff7152c). spriteDraw, windowSprite

Immediate gl* drawing: native since 2026-10-15 (299159f). glEnd's A+D packet read into the 2D path; the bird's heat-haze strips sample the screen copy 0x10f37c8 makes at their layer; bossDeathEffect's fan left out (overwritten on the GS before it is read)
EE game code: native since 2026-10-02 (f48e26f). statically recompiled to C++
EE FPU: native since 2026-10-07 (fa3bae3). recompiled, PS2 rounding
VU0 macro mode: native since 2026-10-02 (3fafa75). recompiled with the EE code

VU1 microcode: native since 2026-10-16 (90ee6b0). with SOTC_NATIVE=1 no VU1 program runs (they only fed the GS); VIF1 still unpacks and keeps TOP/TOPS/DBF; PS2X_VU1_RUN=1 runs them again. CPU per test route 165 s -> 79 s

IOP modules: native since 2026-10-16 (d94cee7). no IOP code runs, boot included: the IRXs are recorded as loaded; sound by the native SG2 driver, DBCMAN by a host service, vibration and the USB console completed without effect; the boot layout made deterministic (the letter post waits for GAMECORE's image)

VIF1 and DMA: native since 2026-10-16 (8e86b02). with SOTC_NATIVE=1 the DMA chains are still walked (tags only) but no data is copied for nothing: the VIF1 stream keeps only its VIFcodes (UNPACK/MPG/DIRECT data left out), and GIF data (VIF1 DIRECT and the GIF channel) is read in place for its event registers only (SIGNAL/FINISH/LABEL). DMA/VIF1/GIF cost on the route about 6x lower; host system time 13 s -> 7 s

GS rasteriser: native since 2026-10-16 (0c1efcb). with SOTC_NATIVE=1 the GS rasterizes nothing and its local memory is not written (texture uploads, CLUT loads skipped); registers and signals still run (PS2X_GS_NODRAW=0 turns it all back on)
GS COLCLAMP wrap: native since 2026-10-15 (0c3a518). emulated GS fix: blends wrap modulo 256 when COLCLAMP is off (the shadow count)
Controller: native since 2026-10-02 (ec4b26d). host gamepad and keyboard
Memory card: native since 2026-10-02 (bc2616e). files on the host
Disc: native since 2026-10-02 (ec4b26d). host file reads

Sound driver (SG2IOPM1.IRX): native since 2026-10-16 (6f1d322). the IRX is not run: RPC 0x11223344 answered on the host, its 36 commands applied to the SPU2 (volumes, pitch, key on/off, transfers, streamed voices, PCM input, reverb studio C). Loudness on the route follows the emulated driver's; on with SOTC_NATIVE=1 (PS2X_NATIVE_SG2=0 turns it off)

SPU2: native since 2026-10-16 (4d6adf4). with SOTC_NATIVE=1 a host mixer (SoundMixer) plays the voices, envelopes, PS2 reverb and streamed PCM; the emulated SPU2 stays idle. Same sound as the emulated SPU2 on the route; PS2X_AUDIO_PULL=1 mixes in the host audio thread (for the Vita); with SOTC_NATIVE=1 the mix runs in the host audio thread (PS2X_AUDIO_PULL), off the game thread

Timers and interrupts: native since 2026-10-16 (). no timer is modelled once the boot is over: T0/T1/T2 stopped after the game arms them; the game library's counters (iosGetTCountExtension, the libkernel system time, the rap counter) read the EE clock, DelayThread is a timed wait on the host scheduler; interrupts (VBlank, DMA completion, GS FINISH) come from host events to the game's own handlers. PS2X_MMIO_CENSUS: 129 register accesses in a whole route, all at boot

EE kernel and threads: native since 2026-10-16 (ec4b26d). the game's threads on the host scheduler (PS2 priority semantics, timed waits on the host clock), syscalls on the host, no PS2 kernel code; the game library's hardware access (scratchpad DMA, display-list kicks, draw-finish test) replaced by host calls
